name: zn15_31_simple_parcellize_q2_x_lines
description: Extra vector: the Q = 2 column of SimpleParcellize's street-line table (§7.5 step 1), which §15's tests never reach (they all give Q = 0 or Q = 3, or run Parcellize). The table gives Q = 2 the same x-line rule as Q = 0 - 'D = 3: x1, +; else x2, -' - and not Q = 1's unconditional 'x2, -', so the start and direction depend on D. Zone 8 -> SimpleParcellize(6) on a 12 x 12 region at x 10..21, z 10..21 with SetOptions(0, 1, 0), a road (type 0) on x = 9, z = 10..21 and nothing else. ExamineCell scores side 3 from the road (12 cells x 100 for network 0x401) and sides 0, 1, 2 by the final 'C = 0 -> S += 1' rule (12 each): S = {12, 12, 12, 1200}, C = {0, 0, 0, 1}, D = 3, and Q = for D in {1,3}: S[0] > S[2] ? 0 : 2 -> 2. flag = 1 (zone 8 is not 1 or 2). With Q = 2 and D = 3 the x pass starts at x1 = 10 ascending, so its counter reaches n = 6 on the 7th line, x = 16 (6 cells from the low edge, 5 from the high edge, both >= 2) and draws there; had the Q = 1 rule been used instead the pass would start at x2 = 21 descending and draw at x = 15. The z pass for Q = 2 starts at z2 = 21 descending and draws at z = 15. Nothing is zoned, so CanCreateLot gives code 2 and all 144 CreateLotToFaceRoad calls fail to make a lot while still consuming their U(4) draw (§14.1 quirk 4); the parcel log holds only the two Place calls.
